terra.problem: The line says Jacob’s family later returned to Mamre, but the cited verses say Jacob returned to Isaac there and, later, his sons carried Jacob to the nearby cave for burial. They do not say his family returned to Mamre.
“Jacob asks to be buried” takes place before Jacob’s body was carried to Canaan, not at Mamre. The moment describes his instructions about the burial place rather than an event at Mamre.
